title: PXAPI analysis run state v1
description: The current state of one Analysis Run (Confluence 39846055 §16; 40239107 §6 persists state and transitions). The top-level state vocabulary is exactly the nineteen canonical states; failure categories stay coarse, and the failure block names the stage that failed so a caller knows which activity failed without any additional top-level state. BLOCKED_INPUT is the one failure that happens before any stage runs and therefore has no stage. Which transitions are legal is decided by pxapi.domain.run_state, not by this document.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this state belongs to.

state.description: Required. The run's current top-level state.

entered_at.description: Required. When the current state was entered.

transitions.description: Required. The ordered audit log of state changes. The first entry is always the entry into REQUESTED (from nothing); every later entry names the state it left. Never empty: a run that exists has been requested. Repeated READY -> DELIVERY_FAILED -> READY entries are legal; v1 derives no attempt count from them.

stage_executions.description: Required. The stage execution records that exist for this run — one per stage that has started, embedded in full. An empty array means no stage has started yet; stages that have not started are not pre-materialised.

failure_stage.description: Required, nullable. The stage whose failure produced the current failure state; null if and only if state is BLOCKED_INPUT, which happens before any stage runs. For every other failure state it must be a stage that maps to that state (e.g. FAILED_COLLECTION from BASELINE_COLLECTION or TARGETED_COLLECTION).

code.description: Required. A stable, client-readable failure code.

failure.description: Conditional. Present if and only if state is one of the six failure states.

from_state.description: Required, nullable. Always null: the first transition enters REQUESTED from nothing.

to_state.description: Required. Always REQUESTED: every run begins there.

at.description: Required. When the run was requested.

entry_transition.description: The first entry of the transition log.

from_state.description: Required. The state the run left.

to_state.description: Required. The state the run entered.

transition.description: Every entry of the transition log after the first.
